name: adlc-team-skills
tagline_zh: 把整个软件开发生命周期交给AI代理团队，从需求到部署自动流转，每个环节都有专属Agent把关，告别手动切换工具。
tagline_en: Hand your entire SDLC to an AI agent team—each stage has a dedicated agent, from requirements to deploy, no.
desc_en: 🐙 ADLC Team Skills — Agentic SDLC for Engineering Teams
why_zh: 它把ADLC方法论固化成可复用的技能集合，让团队协作像流水线一样顺畅，而不是单个AI助手。
why_en: It codifies the ADLC methodology into reusable skills, making team collaboration a smooth pipeline, not just a single AI.
